title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki is sold by his neglectful parents to the demon Sullivan, who adopts him as a grandson and enrolls him at the Babyls School for Demons. Iruma must hide that he is human or risk being eaten, yet his kindness and odd survival skills win him friends such as Asmodeus Alice and Valac Clara. The comedy follows his rise through the school's ranks and his growing sense of belonging.
life_message: It holds up kindness, hard work and a chosen family that loves you as you are.

content.note: Magical duels and school-exam battles; a plot to destroy the school (Wikipedia; ANN Silverman). Mostly comic.
Constant threat that demons will eat Iruma if discovered, handled lightly (Wikipedia).
Light crushes, Ameri's love of a romance manga, Clara trying 'seduction techniques' for laughs (ANN); reviewer of the anime noted little fan service (Wikipedia).
Iruma's parents neglect and sell him, played as exaggerated comedy (Wikipedia; ANN); a character who refuses help (ANN).
Iruma's inability to say no is a running joke; little to imitate.
Anime and spin-offs; no in-story product focus.

delivery.evidence: ANN manga review (vols 2-6) finds themes of friendship and family emerge from character arcs

personified.ideology: kindness and saying yes to others

delivery.note: The message about kindness and found family is carried by Iruma's arcs, and one arc shows the limits of his urge to help.

winners_losers: Kind, adaptable Iruma and his chosen family win; selfish parents and snobbish elites lose. Sympathy goes to found family and to outsiders who earn respect.
